# Fantasy: pinning down eighteen behaviour regressions without a test suite

After picking up a recent build of this library, a large number of things I rely on started coming back wrong, and I spent a day writing down everything I could reproduce from the outside. The repository has received 18 separate undocumented edits. None of what follows is speculation about the internals; it is only what I observed.

Storing a conversation as text and reading it back. A message carrying an attachment — a PNG header, a JPEG, even an empty text file — can no longer be written out at all: the encode step fails instead of handing me bytes. The same failure hits a message holding the outcome of a callable invocation when that outcome is base64 media, while outcomes carrying plain text or a failure notice still survive a write-and-read-back round trip untouched.

Running a turn in which the assistant invokes one of my callables. Asking the finished turn for the outcomes of those invocations hands back the wrong slices of the reply: the plain text, the reasoning and the invocation requests arrive in that list and the produced outcomes do not, so I cannot reach the image or audio bytes a callable returned. The same turn misbehaves at its end, too — a reply asking to stop no longer stops it, and the assistant is queried again for another step.
